[h1]Add New Weapon[/h1]

Bat - A truly baseball bat.

Elastic Shield - Will bounce back and forth between the enemy.

Electronic Sword - It can spawn a laser ball to attack all enemy in the area.


[h1]Add New Buff[/h1]

Auto Attack - A magic ball Auto attack enemy.


[h1]Developer diary[/h1]

The Level 3 is In development. We are working on the boss attack modes and add more skill on the level 3 monster. And we are working on add the other character. Maybe the new character will use the sickle to be his/her weapon.

notes.title: Rogue Along Way - Out Soon
notes.notes:
Welcome to witness our first game - Rogue Along Way. Prepare Your self and take any weapon you like to carry out your own adventure. We hope you will enjoy this game. Although, the game maybe too difficult and there are some Bug need to fix. 
Please subscribe and add the game to your wish list. Also, you can contact us on the Steam forums to tell us your suggustion. We look forward to knowing what you think about our work!





GumRobots Team
